claims: WrestleMania 42 is nicknamed "WrestleMania Vegas".
WrestleMania 42 is a two-night WWE event.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for April 18–19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 Night 1 is on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 is on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix internationally.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on ESPN / Disney+ in the U.S.
Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton is a main event on Night 1 of WrestleMania 42.
World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns is a main event on Night 2 of WrestleMania 42.
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Women's World Championship: Stephanie Vaquer (c) vs. Liv Morgan.
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Women's Intercontinental Championship: AJ Lee (c) vs. Becky Lynch.
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Fatal 4-Way Women's Tag Team Championship: Nia Jax & Lash Legend vs. Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria vs. Nikki & Brie Bella.
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Unsanctioned Match: Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre.
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Tag Team Match: Logan Paul, Austin Theory & IShowSpeed vs. LA Knight & The Usos (Jey & Jimmy).
WrestleMania 42 main card includes Special Match: Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar.
WrestleMania 42 tickets are available via On Location Packages.
Official ticket packages for WrestleMania 42 are sold through On Location.
On Location Champion package features a two-night ticket with premium seating and a ringside photo opportunity.
On Location Trending package features a two-night ticket with all-inclusive pre-show hospitality.
On Location Suite by the Seat provides access to premium suites with food and beverages.
On Location Undertaker Suite provides special suite access with an in-suite appearance by The Undertaker.
WrestleMania 42 weekend schedule on Friday, April 17, 2026 includes WrestleMania Kickoff, SmackDown, and WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony.
